parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, or documented targeting of trans visitors appears in the dossier. Same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2022, and Section 294 enforcement cited dates from 1990-94. Positives include a large Pride rally, gay venues, a gender-neutral toilet backlash that drew no rule change, and a prison datum of 10 trans inmates with no recorded assaults. Negatives are real but mostly resident-facing: healthcare and employment discrimination against trans residents, no gender-identity protection in the new workplace law, and a broadcast-code clause grouping homosexuality with paedophilia. Documented healthcare harassment and a 2019 government stance against same-sex family formation are climate signals. Open questions are border treatment of mismatched documents, custody placement, and emergency-care practice, which are unanswered rather than established exposures. No trans-specific violence rate is available, so the violence axis is undocumented. The visitor-facing record is largely benign and the documented exposures are secondary, placing this in the reduced-risk band.
